title: UTHO ZAMEENE GARM SE BETA UTHO UTHO
body:
Pohnche Hussain Qasim e Bekas ki Laash par
Dekha Wo haal kar na sake doosri nazar
Pehlu me baith kar ye sada di bachashme tar
Ham lene aaye hain Tumhe Dulha UthoUtho
<<MINI>>
Utho zameene garm se BetaUthoUtho
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim Tumhari Maa ko Tumhara hai intezaar
Khaime ke dar pa baali Sakina hai be qaraar
Dada ka naam leke UthoMere jaa'n nisaar
Sote nahi'n hain khaak pa Dulha UthoUtho
<<MINI>>
Utho zameene garm se BetaUthoUtho
<<DIVIDER>>
Tasweer e dard ban gayi Kubra ki zindagi
Jaaga hi tha naseeb ke taqdeer so gayi
Kanghna abhi khila Nahi'n aur maang ujad gayi
Kubra Banaai Jaati hai bewa UthoUtho
<<MINI>>
Utho zameene garm se BetaUthoUtho
<<DIVIDER>>
Fauj e sitam sheyaar bada zulm kargayi
Kya phool se badan pa qayamat guzar gayi
Bhai ki yaadgaar zamee'n par bikhar gayi
Dil khoon ho raha hai Hamara UthoUtho
<<MINI>>
Utho zameene garm se BetaUthoUtho
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum ne Mujhe madad ko Pukara tha Mehlaqa
Par aasaka na waqt pa sharminda hai Chacha
Baalee'n pa ab Tumhari hu'n Rota Khada hua
Do apne GhammeMujhko Dilasaa UthoUtho
<<MINI>>
Utho zameene garm se BetaUthoUtho
<<DIVIDER>>
Karte hain dard o Gham se Haram naala o fughan
Dulha ki raah dekhti hain saari Bibiaan
Hai beqarar Aye MereDilbarTumhari Maa
Karti hai intezaar Tumhara UthoUtho
<<MINI>>
Utho zameene garm se BetaUthoUtho
<<DIVIDER>>
Farwa ke dil ka chain ho Lakhte Dile Hasan
Haidar ki yaadgaar ho Ghaazi ho Saf Shikan
Moula ke saath karta hai Jaweed ye sukhan
Awaaz dete hain Shahe Waala UthoUtho
<<MINI>>
Utho zameene garm se BetaUthoUtho
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
